title: Jesse visits the Richter island site at Bariloche

tellings.quote: Yeah, I've been there actually. I've seen it. A little island off the off the coast of Baroce.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has personally visited a small island off the coast near Bariloche, a town in Argentina, which is linked to a man named Ronald Richter. He mentioned it while talking with a writer, Jason Jorjani, about claims of a secret UFO programme under Hitler. To him, seeing the site makes the story behind it feel more real.
